previousSeasonGameDetailCoverage.note: The other previous-season game pages omit some draw/forfeit details. Published season standings remain authoritative.

interpretation.record: Official league current GP/W/L/T/PTS/GF/GA by source team ID
interpretation.reciprocalGames: Completed nonzero-score matches agreed by both teams' published TeamInfo pages
interpretation.zeroZero: 0-0 placeholder excluded; actual 0-0 ties require independent verification
interpretation.opponentDifficulty: Mean CURRENT published opponent (wins + 0.5 ties)/GP, not a predictive rating
interpretation.previousWinter: 2025/26 season remains separate and linked only where official player-ID overlap substantiates team continuity
interpretation.historicHeadToHead: Brave H.C. Master Workbook / HTO canonical matchup aggregates, never inferred from league rename
interpretation.crossDivision: Opponent division labels are CURRENT as of source capture, not guaranteed division labels on the original game date
interpretation.smallSample: 2026/27 has only the currently published first few league games. Do not treat record ranks as predicted playoff strength.

incomingCristilloReports.interpretation: Source-supported context only. Previous league membership date is not inferred.

strengthModel.source: Current official SVHL reciprocal games; independent roster-supported previous winter; no Brave H.C. H2H scoring input
strengthModel.formDefinition: 70% smoothed (W+0.5T)/GP; 30% shrunk goal-difference per game, capped +/-4
strengthModel.oppositionDefinition: Average opponent (W+0.5T)/GP with THIS matchup removed, smoothed by 4 neutral pseudogames
strengthModel.notice: Descriptive 0–100 context index. Not calibrated to outcomes, not a win probability or forecast. Teams with 1–4 games are early-sample.

trendLedger.baselineNote: First point is the accepted public source at tracking adoption; no inferred earlier scores. Unchanged refreshes add no points.

weeklyLedger.source: Source-qualified SVHL current standings and context index
weeklyLedger.note: Each week is represented by its latest accepted source capture. Prior closed weeks are immutable. Weekly comparisons are descriptive, not official division assignments.
